gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: abdominal pain as chief complaint. The gold-level simpler statement is not explicitly present as a discrete fact.

Worsening pain is covered; the new symptom described (unable to keep fluids down) is one example of new/worrying symptoms, so the safety-net concept is broadly covered though not identical.

Gold says light PV bleeding but does not relate it temporally to 2 weeks after LMP. The timing detail is new.
Gold has nausea and separate denial of vomiting/diarrhoea; generated states nausea without vomiting. This fits the gold ROS.

Gold HPI-006 and HPI-005: constipation for a week last week, now BO daily with normal stool. Generated matches prior constipation last week and now daily BMs, but omits normal stool consistency; it is partially supported but incomplete relative to gold.

Gold ROS-001: denies urinary frequency (i.e., no increased frequency). Gold also notes some difficulty passing urine. Generated states decreased urinary frequency. These are different and potentially opposite emphases; generated introduces a change in frequency not present in gold and conflicts with the gold ROS wording.
Gold ROS-001 denies dysuria/frequency, but says nothing about odor or urgency. Generated denies dysuria, odor, and urgency. Dysuria denial is supported; odor and urgency are additions.

Generated says no fever, SOB, shoulder pain, or presyncope, which corresponds to no SOB, no shoulder tip pain, and not feeling faint, but modifies how fever is expressed and omits that temp was not checked or that she does not feel feverish. Partially supported with additions (explicit SOB, presyncope) and slight shifts.
